m: वि-√ या P. -याति, to go or pass through, traverse, cross, drive through (with a car), cut through (with wheels), destroy, RV.; MaitrS.; ŚBr.; to depart, turn away, MaitrS.; BhP.
वियाङ्ग See 2. अव्यङ्ग.
वि-याम m. (only L.) a partic. measure of length (= a fathom measured by the two extended arms)
forbearance, restraint
rest, stop, cessation, pain, distress.

k.v: प्रवाहस्तु प्रवृत्तिः स्यात्प्रवहो गमनं बहिः। वियामो वियमो यामो यमः संयामसंयमौ॥

m: वि-यास m. (√ यस्) N. of a partic. demon who inflicts torment in Yama's world, VS.; TS.

s: tri, (virudDaM nindAM yAtaH prAptaH .) nirlajjaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + yA--kta yAti ac vA । 1 Dfzwe 2 nirlajje ca amaraH । tasya BAvaH zyaY । vEyAtya nirlajjatve na॰ “vEyAtyaMsuratezvapi” mAGaH ।
m: वि-˚यात mfn. ‘gone apart or from the right path’, shameless, impudent, ill-behaved, L.
a: वियात — a. 1 Bold(धृष्ट). --2 Audacious, shameless, impudent. --3 Abandoned, wretched.

k.v: वश्यः प्रणेयो निभृतविनीतप्रश्रिताः समाः। धृष्टे धृष्णग्वियातश्च प्रगल्भः प्रतिभान्विते॥

m: वि-˚यात—ता f. = next, Śiś.
वि-˚यातिमन् m. shamelessness, impudence, L.
वि—यूथ mfn. separated from its herd, MBh.
वियूष्क mfn. being without gravy, HirP.
वियङ्ग See 2. अव्यङ्ग.
वियच् in comp. for वि-यत्.

s: [n] puM, (viyati AkASe caratIti । cara + RiniH .) cillaH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ AkASagAmini, tri ॥

m: वियच्—चारिन् m. ‘sky-goer’, Falco Cheela (= चिल्ल), L.
वियच्—चर mfn. flying through the air, MBh.
वियद् in comp. for वि-यत्.
वियद्—भूति f. ‘sky-power’, darkness, ib.

v: strI viyatsTA gaNgA SAka॰ । svargagaNgAyAM mandAkinyAma amaraH ।
m: वियद्—गङ्गा f. the heavenly Ganges i.e. the galaxy, L.

k.v: मन्दाकिनी वियद्गङ्गा स्वर्णदी सुरदीर्घिका। मेरुः सुमेरुर्हेमाद्री रत्नसानुः सुरालयः॥

m: वियद्—गत mfn. moving or flying in the air, MBh.; Śiś.
वियद्—गति f. motion in the air, W.
वियद्—व्यापिन् mfn. filling the air, Vṛṣabhān.

वि-√ यम् P. -यच्छति (3. pl. pf. Ā. -येमिरे, RV. iv, 54, 5), to spread out, extend, RV.; to stretch out the legs, step out (as a running horse), ib.; to hold apart or asunder, ib. : Caus. -यामयति to stretch out, extend, AV.
a: वियम् — {c1c} P. 1 To spread out, extend. --2 To curb, restrain. --3 To give, grant, bestow.

s: puM, (vi + yama + “yamaH samupanivizu ca .” 3 । 3 । 63 । ityap .) saMyamaH । ityamaraH ॥ duHKam । iti svAmI ॥
v: pu॰ vi + yama--GaY । 1 saMyame amaraH । 2 duHKe kzIrasvAmI । pakze vfdDiH । viyAma tatrArTe
m: वि-यम m. (only L.) = next, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 63.
a: वियमः — 1 Restraint, check, control. --2 Distress, pain, affliction. --3 Cessation, stop.

k.v: प्रवाहस्तु प्रवृत्तिः स्यात्प्रवहो गमनं बहिः। वियामो वियमो यामो यमः संयामसंयमौ॥

m: वियन् in comp. for वि-यत्.
वियन्—मध्य-हंस m. ‘the flamingo in the middle of the sky’, the sun, Daś.

v: pu॰ viyato maRiriva prakASakatvAt BUzakatvAdvA dyumaRO sUryye hArA॰ ।
m: वियन्—मणि m. ‘sky-jewel’, the sun, L.
वियन्—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of air, Hcar.
वि—यन्तृ mfn. deprived of a guide, MBh.

s: klI, (viyacCati na viramatIti । vi + yama + “anyeByo'pi dfSyate .” 3 । 2 । 178 । iti kvip । kvO cagamAdInAmiti malope tuk .) AkASam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 3 । 8 । 33 । “tarhyeva tannABisaraHsarojamAtmAnamamBaH SvasanaM viyacca । dadarSa devo jagato viDAtA nAtaH paraM lokavisargadfzwiH ॥” dyavApfTivyO । atra dbivacanasya prayogaH syAt । yaTA, tEttirIyabrAhmaRe । 1 । 1 । 3 । 2 । “dyAvApfTivI sahAstAm । te viyatI abrUtAm ॥” taTAca SatapaTabrAhmaRe । 7 । 1 । 2 । 23 । “tayorviyatyoryo'ntareRAkASa AsIt tadantarikzamaBavat ॥” * ॥ vi + yA + Satf । gamanaSIle, tri । yaTA, BAgavate । 7 । 6 । 14 । “kuwumbapozAya viyannijAyurna buDyate'rTaM vihataM pramattaH ॥” taTA, tatrEva । 9 । 21 । 3 । “viyadbittasya dadato labDaM labDaM buBUzataH । nizkiYcanasya DIrasya sakuwumbasya sIdataH । vyatIyurazwacatvAriMSadahAnyapibataH kila ॥” “viyadvittasya viyato gaganAdiva udyamaM vinEva dEvAdupasTitaM vittaM BogyaM yasya । yadvA viyat vyayaM prApnuvadvittaM BogyaM yasya .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥)
v: na॰ vi + yama--kvip malope tuk । AkASe amaraH ।
m: 1. वि-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to dispose in various rows, AV. : Caus. -यातयति, to place in rows, arrange, TS.; to do penance, AV.; to torment, pain, punish, MBh.
2. वि-यत् mfn. (pr. p. of वि- √ 5. इ) going apart or asunder, RV. i, 164, 38
being dissolved, passing away, vanishing, BhP.
वि-यत् n. the sky, heaven, air, atmosphere (prob. as ‘that which parts asunder or forms the intermediate region between heaven and earth’), VS. &c. &c.
ether (as an element), BhP.; Sarvad.
N. of the 10th mansion, VarBṛS.
a kind of metre, VS.
a: वियत् — n. The {{aky->sky||20200617|User saurabh.kapoor|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/291|1957 edition has 'sky'}}, atmosphere, ether; पश्योदग्रवतत्वाद्बियति बहुतरं स्तोकमुर्व्यां प्रयाति Ś. 1. 7; R. 13. 40. --Comp. --गंगा {1} the heavenly Ganges. {2} the galaxy. --चारिन् ( वियच्चारिन्) m. a kite. --भूतिः f. darkness. --मणिः (वियन्मणिः) the sun.

k.v: द्योदिवौ द्वे स्त्रियामभ्रं व्योम पुष्करमम्बरम्. नभोऽन्तरिक्षं गगनमनन्तं सुरवर्त्म खम्. वियद्विष्णुपदं वा तु पुंस्याकाशविहायसी। विहायसोऽपि नाकोऽपि द्युरपि स्यात्तदव्ययम्. तारापथोऽन्तरिक्षं च मेघाध्वा च महाबिलम्. विहायाः शकुने पुंसि गगने पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

m: वि-यत mfn. stretched out, extended, kept apart, RV.; AV.
वि-यतम् (अम्), ind. separately, at intervals, intermittingly, ŚrS.
वियति m. N. of one of the six sons of Nahuṣa, Pur.
a bird, L.
वि-यत्—पथ m. ‘sky-path’, the atmosphere, Dharmaś.
वि-यत्—पताका f. ‘sky-banner’, lightning, Ṛt. iii, 12.
वि-यत्—स्थ mfn. standing or being in the air, MBh.
वि—यव m. a kind of intestinal worm, Suśr.
वि—योध mfn. deprived of combatants, ib.
वि-योध , वि-योनि &c. See p. 952, col. 1.
वि-यो˚गावह mfn. bringing or causing separation, Śāntiś.
वि-यो˚गावसान mfn. ending in s˚ (-त्व n.), MW.
वि-यो˚गावसान—त्व n.
वि-योगाय Nom. Ā., ˚यते, to be like or resemble a separation, Subh.

s: [n] puM, (viyogo'syAstIti । viyoga + iniH .) cakravAkaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ viyogayukte, tri ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 22 । 25 । “tAH SocyA yA viyoginyo na SocyA yA mftAH saha । BartturvviyogastvanayA nAnuBUtaH kftajYayA ॥”)

m: वियोगी-करण n. causing separation = हिंसा, Śīl.

s: puM, (vi + yuja + GaY .) vicCedaH । tatparyyAyaH । vipralamBaH 2 viprayogaH 3 virahaH 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 9 । 13 । 9 । “yasya yogaM na vAYCanti viyogaBayakAtarAH । Bajanti caraRAmBojaM munayo harimeDasaH ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + yaja--GaY । 1 vicCede hemaca॰ 6 ta॰ 2 pakziyoge ca gaRitaprasidDe 3 rASyorvyavakalane ca ।
m: वि-योग m. disjunction, separation (esp. of lovers), loss or absence or want of (instr. with or with out सह abl., or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (˚गं √ गम्, to be lost, Mṛcch. ix, 34/35)
giving up, getting rid of, abstention from (comp.), Gaut.
subtraction, Gaṇit.
= वि-युति, Bījag.
a partic. astrological Yoga, Cat.
a: वियोगः — 1 Separation, disunion; अयमेकपदे तया वियोगः सहसा चोपनतः सुदुःसहो मे V. 4. 3; त्वयोपस्थितवियोगस्य तपोवनस्यापि समवस्था दृश्यते Ś. 4; संधत्ते भृशमरतिं हि सद्वियोगः Ki. 5. 51; R. 12. 10; Me. 88; Śi. 12. 63. --2 Absence, loss. --3 Subtraction.

m: वि-योग—भाज् mfn. suffering from s˚, W.

s: [j] tri, (viyogaM Bajate iti । Baja + viR .) vicCedayuktaH । yaTA, nEzaDe । “viyogaBAjo'pi nfpasya paSyatA tadeva sAkzAdamftAMSumAnanam । pikena rozAruRacakzuzA muhuH kuhUrutAhUyata candravEriRI ॥”

m: वि-योग—बाह्य mfn. excluded from separation, not separated, MW.
वि-योग—पुर n. N. of a town, ib.
वि-योग—ता f. w.r. for ˚गि-ता (q.v.), Kathās.
वि-योग—तस् ind. (ifc.) from want of, in consequence of any one's absence, Kathās.

v: pu॰ vi + yuja--GinuR । 1 cakravAke pakziRi Sabdaca॰ । 2 vicCedavati । 3 pakziyogavati ca tri॰ । striyAM NIp “viyoginImEkzata dAqimImasO” nEza॰ ।
m: वि-योगिन् mfn. separated or absent from (instr. or comp.), Kathās.; MārkP.; Dhūrtas.
liable to separation (see अ-व्˚)
वि-योगिन् m. the ruddy goose, Anas Casarca (cf. चक्रवाक), L.
a: वियोगिन् — a. 1 Separated. --2 Absent, apart. --m. The ruddy goose.

m: वि-योगिनी f. a woman separated from her husband or lover, MW.
a kind of metre (commonly called वैतालीय, q.v.)
a: वियोगिनी — 1 A woman separated from her lover or husband; गुरुनिःश्वसितैः कपिर्मनीषी निरणैषीदथ तां वियोगिनीति Bv. 4. 35. --2 N. of a metre; (see App. I).

m: वि-यो˚गि-ता f. the being separated, separation, Kathās.
वि-˚योजनीय mfn. to be separated from or deprived of (instr.), Kull. on Mn. viii, 374.
वि-योजन n. detaching or liberating from (comp.), Sarvad.
separation from (comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.
subtraction, Līl.

s: tri, viyogaM prApitaH । vipUrvvaYyantayujaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: वि-˚योजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) disjoined, disunited, separated from or deprived of (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: वियोजित — p. p. 1 Separated. --2 Separated from, deprived of.

m: वि-˚योज्य mfn. to be separated from (abl.), Pañcat.
वि—योनि f. the womb of animals, debased (or ‘manifold’) birth (of plants and animals), Mn.; MBh. &c. (also ˚नी)
वि—योनि mfn. contrary to one's own nature, PañcavBr.; Kāṭh.
destitute of vulva, Suśr.
of low origin, MBh. (Nīlak.)
a: वियोनिः --नी — f. 1 Manifold birth. --2 The womb of animals (Kull. on Ms. 12. 77). --3 A debased or ignominious birth.

m: वि—योनि—ज m. or n. ‘sprung from a low origin’, an animal, MBh.
वि—योनि—जन्˚माध्याय m. N. of ch. of VarBṛS.
वि—योनि—जन्मन् n. the birth of animals and plants
वि—योनि—जन्मन् mfn. having an animal for mother, MārkP.
वि-योतृ mfn. one who divides or separates, RV. iv, 55, 5.
वि-योतृ See under वि-√ यु.

वि-√ यु P. -युयोति, -यौति, to separate, part (intr.), RV.; AV.; to be separated from or deprived of (instr.), RV.; VS.; to separate (trans.), divide, detach or exclude from, deprive of (instr.), RV.; to keep off, avert, Śiś.; to spread, scatter, TS.; to open, RV.
a: वियु — {c3c} P. 1 To be separated or dissolved (intran.). --2 To lose or be deprived of. --3 To exclude, deprive of. --4 To keep or ward off, prevent.

m: वि—युगल mfn. not fitting together, Nalac.

वि-√ युज् P. Ā. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, to disjoin, detach, divide, separate from or deprive of (instr., rarely abl.), AV. &c. &c.; to part from (instr.), Śaṃk.; (Ā.) to forsake, abandon (acc.), Kir.; to relax, abate, yield, BhP. : Pass. -युज्यते, to be separated from or deprived of, lose (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to break (a vow instr.), Mn., v, 91; to be relaxed, yield, give way, R. : Caus. -योजयति, ˚ते, to cause to be disjoined, separate or deliver from, deprive of (instr. or abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to rob, MBh.; to subtract, Līl.
a: वियुज् — {c7c} A. 1 To leave, abandon; part with, forsake; मदमानसमुद्धतं नृपं न वियुंक्ते नियमेन मूढता Ki. 2. 49; R. 13. 63. --2 To separate; पुरो वियुक्ते मिथुने कृपावती Ku. 5. 26. --3 To relax, slacken. --4 To disjoin, divide, sever. --5 To free or deliver from, deprive of (with instr.); प्राणैर्न वियोजयति Pt. 1; असुभिर्न वियुज्यते K. 38. --Caus. 1 To separate. --2 To free from, deprive of; अजानता मया सैव पत्रैः शाखा वियोजिता Mk. 4. 18.

s: tri, viyogaviSizwaH । vipUrvvayujaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, devIBAgavate । 2 । 9 । 13 । “kiM karomi kvagacCAmi mftAme prARavallaBA । na vE jIvitumicCAmi viyuktaH priyayAnayA ॥”)
m: वि-युक्त mfn. disjoined, detached, separated or delivered from, deprived or destitute of, deserted by (instr. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
disunited (as husband and wife), Mn. ix, 102
failing, deficient, MW.
a: वियुक्त — p. p. 1 Detached, severed, separated. --2 Separated from, deserted by. --3 Free from, deprived of (with instr. or in comp.). --4 Failing, deficient.

m: वि-युक्त—ता f. (ifc.) the being free from, L.
वि-युता (आ), f. du. ‘the two separated ones’, heaven and earth, RV. iii, 54, 7
वि-यु˚तार्थक mfn. void of meaning, L.
वि-युत mfn. separated from, deprived of (instr. or comp.), RV. &c. &c.
not being in conjunction with (comp.), VarBṛS.
diminished, that from which something has been subtracted, Sūryas.
a: वियुत — p. p. 1 Deprived of, separated from; V. 4. 18. --2 Without, devoid of.

m: वि-˚युति f. the difference between two quantities, Bījag.
